summary: v21 batch verification (GökyüzüWebSpam) — 4 features tested. Backend pytest: 6/6 PASS covering (1) trust-score/snapshot upsert + same-day idempotency, (2) trust-score/history returns 30-entry series with avg/min/max/delta, (3) geo/country-detail returns items with ip/reason/created_at/source for US and empty items for unknown CC, (4) auto-cleanup/run-now with email_to composes body (30-day trend + top 10 country) and logs to maintenance_log. critical_code_review_comments: routes/maintenance.py trust-score/snapshot uses upsert on date key — clean idempotency, verified via same-day double-write test.
routes/maintenance.py trust-score/history correctly fills gap dates with score=null and computes avg/min/max/delta only on non-null scores.

routes/maintenance.py geo/country-detail dedupes IPs via 'seen' set across db.lists and db.threat_iocs — prevents same IP counted twice (nice improvement over heatmap endpoint which still can double-count).
routes/maintenance.py _run_auto_cleanup_once email body composition wraps trend + top10 country blocks each in try/except so partial failures don't break the cron.
GeoBlockedHeatmap.js CountryDetailModal properly stops event propagation on modal content so backdrop-click-to-close works only when clicking outside — solid UX.
Sidebar badge pendingPayments useQuery polls every 15s — verified by network log; badge hides when count=0 based on conditional render.

Security.js TrustDashboard useEffect fires POST /trust-score/snapshot on mount — verified via history endpoint showing today's row updated with latest dashboard score (which shifted delta from seeded +47 to +37 — this is expected behavior, not a bug).
